anomalies.observed: The three TMC2209 charge-pump capacitors are connected from the VCP nets to the +24V rail instead of to ground.
anomalies.expected: The TMC2209 datasheet requires the VCP capacitor to be connected from VCP to GND; connecting it to the motor-supply rail prevents the internal gate-driver charge pump from being referenced correctly.
anomalies.impact: The stepper drivers U5/U6/U7 may fail to generate proper gate drive, so the three dosing pumps would not operate reliably or at all.
